48.original: After witnessing a spectacle like that, everyday life seems rather dull in comparison...

49.original: Hm? So you didn't see that trial earlier? Ah, your loss. Fury take me, the way that heretic swung that slab of iron he called a sword was a sight to behold!

50.original: He couldn't have carried a shield if he'd wanted to, the blade was so big. Had to keep two hands on it at all times! I was amazed he managed to keep up with that Temple Knight for as long as he did.

51.original: Fought like a demon from the deepest pits of the seventh hell, bellowing threats and working his arts. I wasn't sure what to make of it at first, but then I heard someone say that he must be a <hex:021A020203>dark knight<hex:021A020103>!

52.original: B-But you didn't hear that from me, eh!? In fact, I'm sure I don't know anything about it!

56.original: Ye gods, are you mad!? We're standing outside the bloody Tribunal!

57.original: Fine, fine! But keep quiet and listen well, because I'm only going to say this once!

58.original: Aye, aye. Let us speak no more of such things. Never know who's listening...
